name: opennolan-hyperframes-runtime
description: Pinned HyperFrames install for OpenNolan's composition tier (OPN-3). Provisioned into the writable runtime via `npm ci` so `hyperframes` renders from a local, deterministic, offline copy instead of a live `npx --yes hyperframes` fetch. Bump the version deliberately + regenerate the lockfile: `npm install --package-lock-only --prefix composition/hyperframes`.
